ranked.headline: Structural priors and hierarchical losses are being built into single-cell inference…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications embed ontology graphs, hierarchical losses, and multilevel structure into single-cell inference objectives.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models decode spatial multi-omics from transcriptomic and imaging data
ranked.summary: Incomplete and multimodal spatial omics data motivate methods that embed tissue niche and spatial structure in their representations.

ranked.headline: Coverage bias, annotation validity, and integration sensitivity in scRNA-seq workflows
ranked.summary: Recent tools and benchmarks test coverage bias, annotation transfer, and integration parameters as checkable error sources before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for haplotype assembly, repeat genotyping, and regulatory decoding
ranked.summary: Recent items report haplotype-resolved assembly, pangenome graphs, and telomere-scale long-read analysis with reduced computational demands.

ranked.headline: Microbial sequence tools trade memory and scale against accuracy in metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work tests scalability, reproducibility and alignment choices in pangenome, metagenomic and phylogenetic software as measurable variables.

ranked.headline: Methods infer regulatory activity and chromatin contacts from epigenomic data
ranked.summary: Regulatory annotation is now being linked to expression, chromatin contact and mutation outcomes across new sequence and epigenomic models.

ranked.headline: Machine learning benchmarks test model choice and design across genomic prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Published and preprint studies now scrutinize model architecture and training design against simple baselines rather than proposing new architectures.

ranked.headline: Tools extend transcriptomic data into metabolic flux and cell-cell communication layers
ranked.summary: Recent Bioinformatics tools pair transcriptomic data with metabolite, flux, multi-omics, and 3D genome analyses.

ranked.headline: Predicting spatial gene expression and tissue domains from histology and transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Graph and generative models now infer spatial gene expression and tissue domains directly from histology and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Representation learning on gigapixel and whole-organ histology and tomography data
ranked.summary: Foundation-model and deep learning pipelines now target whole-slide and tomography datasets at gigapixel and whole-organ scale.

ranked.headline: Language models over biological sequences: scaling, repetition control, and fitness
ranked.summary: Recent preprints probe scaling, representation choice, and objective design for protein, genome, and molecular sequence models.

ranked.headline: Deep learning exploits gene regulatory structure for perturbation and network inference
ranked.summary: Billion-parameter single-cell foundation models and parameter-efficient transfer of regulatory sequence models are now extending these methods to new contexts…

ranked.headline: Biological structure shapes neural and single-cell models and how they are interpreted
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed biological structure in model design and test whether learned internal mechanisms match biological criteria.

ranked.headline: Geometry-aware deep learning for protein, peptide, and antibody design and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed 3D geometry and domain topology directly into generative and predictive models of antibodies, peptides, and proteins.

ranked.headline: Tools extract dynamic and conformational features from protein structures and simulations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers extend structure-based tools to MD ensembles, induced-fit docking, and sequence-based dynamics prediction.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings and structured priors for drug and gene association prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs pretrained language embeddings with ontologies, MeSH graphs, and interaction networks to predict drug, target, and gene associations.

ranked.headline: Mechanical and electrical cues predicted to steer single-cell engulfment and migration
ranked.summary: Biophysical models now predict stiffness-dependent engulfment modes and electrotaxis overriding durotaxis under defined mechanical constraints.

ranked.headline: Phylodynamic models refine inference of somatic, viral, and protein sequence evolution
ranked.summary: Recent work extends phylogenetic and phylodynamic likelihood models to somatic mutation, within-host viral migration, and indel-substitution dynamics.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases link cell-type identity to regulatory elements in human brain
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus histone and transcriptome atlases now resolve regulatory programs across human brain regions at cell-type resolution.

ranked.headline: Polymer models reconstruct loci organization from contact and nucleosome data
ranked.summary: Physics-based simulations now couple 3D genome organization to nucleosome positioning, supercoiling, and predicted regulatory output.

ranked.headline: Recombination and structural change drive divergent genome evolution across eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Allele-aware assemblies and pedigree sequencing now resolve recombination, mutation and structural change across hybrid, parasitic and plastid genomes.

ranked.headline: Experimental restraints and energetics are coupled to simulated conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Multi-replica restraint simulations and temperature-dependent potentials now reconstruct disordered-protein ensembles against SAXS, PRE, and hydration data.

ranked.headline: LLMs grounded in external biomedical databases, models, and literature indices
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool link LLM outputs to curated models, literature, and interaction knowledge bases that can be checked against source data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking variant classification tools and standardizing qualifying variant criteria
ranked.summary: ACMG/AMP classification tools were benchmarked on 151 Mendelian datasets, and qualifying variant criteria are being decoupled from pipeline code.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene content and RNA structure to habitat and ecology
ranked.summary: Expanding genome-resolved and orthology-based comparisons now reach deep-sea catalogues, groundwater viromes and cyanobacterial RNA structure scans.

ranked.headline: Learned and comparative methods are refining genome and transcript feature annotation
ranked.summary: Recent tools apply learned and comparative strategies to replication origins, introgression, genome comparison, piRNAs, and chromatin loops.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of viral variant identity and mixtures from sequence data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend variant classification and mixture quantification to SARS-CoV-2, HIV-1, and influenza A viruses.

ranked.headline: Bias-aware methods sharpen quantification of small, circular and polyadenylated RNAs
ranked.summary: Library chemistry and ligation bias shape small RNA, circRNA and polyadenylation measurements, making technical correction central to quantification.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies enable allele-specific analysis of polyploid genomes
ranked.summary: Phased autopolyploid and cultivar assemblies, paired with long-read allele-aware tools, make haplotype-level analysis of genome structure and expression…

ranked.headline: Simulations link Complex I hydration networks and quinone binding to proton transport
ranked.summary: Atomistic and reactive MD now quantify hydration connectivity in Complex I, tying it to an LHON mutation's effects and proton pathways.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict membrane contact and binding, anchored by molecular dynamics
ranked.summary: MD-derived training data now underpin models of peptide membrane contact, protein binding interfaces, and lipid delivery design.

ranked.headline: Moran-type stochastic models infer mtDNA deletion timing from single-cell snapshots
ranked.summary: Cross-sectional single-cell data and long-read sequencing now enable inference of mutation timing and genomic insertion architecture.

ranked.headline: Structure-based frameworks map substitution effects on TCR recognition and ATG9A
ranked.summary: Single-residue substitutions in antigens, TCRs, and ATG9A are now assessed computationally at scale using structures and multiple sequence alignments.

ranked.headline: Protein language models and LLMs predict mutation, editability and PAM specificity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one 2026 publication test whether learned models can rank, audit, and steer predictions of mutation and editing outcomes.

ranked.headline: Evaluation Rigor Shapes Machine Learning Models of Compound Toxicity
ranked.summary: Cross-species concordance and benchmark studies show how data design and evaluation choices shape reported ML toxicity performance.

ranked.headline: Software tools for batch correction, cfDNA fragment analysis and proteomics QC
ranked.summary: Routine QC, normalization and batch correction for mass spectrometry and cell-free DNA datasets are increasingly packaged as standalone, shareable software…

ranked.headline: Encoding heterogeneity in structured models yields analytic outcome criteria
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model map how heterogeneity in structured populations sets stability, coexistence, and cooperation thresholds.

ranked.headline: Pathogenicity predictors are being scaled to missense and synonymous variant annotation
ranked.summary: Large-scale annotation resources and LLM frameworks now integrate multiple evidence layers for deleterious variant and Mendelian disease interpretation.

ranked.headline: Orthology and tree-aware software for scalable comparative omics analysis
ranked.summary: Large orthology- and tree-structured datasets call for scalable, accessible software for functional and trait analysis across species.

ranked.headline: Evaluating search algorithms and acquisition workflows in LC-MS proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent tools and benchmarks address peptide quantification depth, library search, and instrument QC across DDA and DIA workflows.
